senses.gloss: a sole with straps, shoe, contrad. to מַנְעָל a. נַעַל.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 102a:15">Yeb. 102ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—<he>ס׳ של בהמה</he> a sort of shoe for animals (v. Sm. Ant., 3rd Engl. ed., s. v. Solea).

<cite ref="Shabbat 59a:6">Sabb. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>ס׳ של וכ׳</he> a metal shoe for animals is liable to levitical uncleanness (expl. ‘because it may be used as a drinking vessel in war’ &c.); <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 14:5">Kel. XIV, 5</cite> <he>סַנְדְּלֵי בהמה</he> (pl.).

Par. II, 3 עשה לה ס׳ וכ׳ if one made a shoe for her (the red cow), that she might not slip.—ס׳ של עריסה a sort of shoe for the legs of a bedstead; [Ar.: a board placed under a short leg]. Ohol. XII, 4; Tosef. ib. XIII, 4.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 103b:7">Yeb. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ של נחת ע״ז</he> Ar. (ed. <he>ס׳ של ע״ז</he>) the shoe for the rest of an idol.—Pl. <he>סַנְדָּלִין</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 58a:2">B. Bath. 58ᵃ</cite> ‘the bed of a scholar’ is <he>כל שאין … ס׳ וכ׳</he> that under which nothing is placed except the sandals in summer and shoes in winter time.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:2:2">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: a flat fish like the sole or turbot; trnsf. a flat, fish-shaped abortion.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 3:4">Nidd. III, 4</cite> <he>המפלת ס׳ וכ׳</he> a woman who discharges a sandal-like foetus or a placenta.

<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 4:7">Tosef. ib. IV, 7</cite> <he>ס׳ שאמרו דומה לס׳ דג שבים</he> the sandal abortion of which they speak means a foetus resembling the sea-fish called sandal; [oth. opin.] <he>דומה ללשון של שור</he> resembling the fish called ‘oxtongue’ (βοὐγλοσσος, lingulaca); Y.

<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 4:7">ib.</cite> ib. III, 50ᵈ bot.; Bab. ib. 25ᵇ; a. e. [<cite ref="Sanhedrin 59b">Snh. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>סנדלין</he> Ms. M., v. <cite ref="O01182"><he>סנְדֵּלְכוֹנִים</he></cite>.]
